01 TikTok: Your Primary Rook
TK
TikTok
Fastest organic reach in Nigeria right now
Why TikTok First Algorithm favors new accounts. 60-90 second videos require zero production budget. Fastest path from zero to audience in Nigeria today.
Day Format Example Hook CTA
Mon Value Bomb "3 mistakes killing your remote job applications" Link in bio for free checklist
Tue Story "How I went from ₦0 to €2k/month in 90 days" Join my free Telegram
Wed Tutorial "This LinkedIn message got me 5 interviews" Free template in bio
Thu Reaction "Reacting to the worst remote job pitch I've seen" Comment 'REMOTE' for guide
Fri Q&A "Answering your remote work questions" DM me your question
Sat Behind Scenes "My daily routine as a remote B2B sales rep" Follow for more
Sun Repurpose Best performing video of the week Same CTA as original
The Rule Every video must do one of three things — educate, entertain, or agitate. Preferably two of three.
CTA Pattern — Per Video
0 – 3s
Hook — problem or curiosity gap. Grab them before the scroll.
3 – 50s
Value delivery — the "what." Give it freely. Don't hold back.
50 – 60s
CTA — the "where." Telegram link, Selar free module, comment keyword.

03 Nairaland + Forums: Your Trust Layer
NL
Nairaland
Where serious Nigerians go for serious information
Why Nairaland Nigerians trust Nairaland more than Instagram. High-intent readers. A single thread can generate leads for 12+ months.
Your Playbook
#ActionDetail
1 Value Thread "My 6-Month Journey from Unemployed to €2k/Month Remote B2B Sales Rep" — post weekly updates, share real numbers (anonymized), answer every question genuinely
2 Forum Signature "Free training: How to land remote B2B sales roles with European companies. [Selar link]"
3 Cross-Post Reddit r/Nigeria (weekly) · Reddit r/remotejobs (bi-weekly) · Twitter/X threads (daily)
The Rule Give 90% value, 10% pitch. The signature does the selling.

07 Week 1 — Exact Launch Sequence
DayActionPlatformDeliverable
1 Create TikTok account. Film 3 videos using phone + natural light. TikTok 3 videos ready to post
2 Create YouTube channel. Film EP 1 using screen share + voiceover. YouTube 1 video uploaded
3 Set up Selar store. Upload Module 0 (free) + Module 1 (₦15k). Selar Live store with 2 products
4 Create Telegram group. Design pinned message + welcome flow. Telegram 50 members (invite your network)
5 Post on Nairaland: "Starting my remote work journey — documenting everything." Nairaland 1 thread + signature with Selar link
6 LAUNCH DAY: Post all 3 TikToks. Share YouTube EP 1 in Telegram. Announce in Nairaland. All Live traffic flowing
7 Engage: Reply to every comment, DM, and question for 4 hours. All 100+ interactions, 10+ leads

RISK
Time filming2–3 hours/day. But you're already at ground zero — this is your job now.

No sales initiallyNormal. Free module builds list. List builds trust. Trust builds sales.

09 The Chess Principle
"TikTok and YouTube are your rooks — they control open files. Telegram is your knight — it jumps between free and paid. Selar is your queen — maximum mobility, maximum power. Your king is the trading fund. Protect it by not touching it until the position is winning."
♜ Rooks
TikTok + YouTube
Control open files. Drive traffic down open columns toward the king.
♞ Knight
Telegram
Jumps between free and paid. Reaches squares other pieces can't.
♛ Queen
Selar
Maximum mobility. Maximum power. The revenue engine.
♚ King
Trading Fund
Protect it. Don't touch it until the position is winning.
The Mandate You don't need to be on every platform. Own one traffic channel (TikTok), one authority channel (YouTube), one community channel (Telegram), one revenue channel (Selar). That's it.
